Fetch the user's GitHub activity (PRs, commits, reviews) through the gh CLI and link it to journal entries. Needs gh signed in. `since` is a local day or an ISO timestamp; the default is the last sync.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `since` | `string` | no | Start date: a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp |

## Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `status` | `"ok" \| "partial" \| "skipped" \| "failed"` | yes |  |
| `since` | `string` | yes |  |
| `inserted` | `number` | yes |  |
| `updated` | `number` | yes |  |
| `linked` | `number` | yes |  |
| `warning` | `string \| null` | yes |  |
